title: Ruby: Methods and Blocks
description: Write a Ruby program demonstrating method definitions, blocks, procs, and lambdas.
verificationTest: output.includes('Hello, Ruby!') && output.includes('3 + 5 = 8') && output.includes('1 squared = 1') && output.includes('Proc result: 20')
hints: Methods return the last expression evaluated
Blocks are chunks of code passed to methods, using `do..end` or `{..}`
Procs are objects that wrap blocks, lambdas are a special type of Proc
`yield` calls the block passed to a method
